p: of a strange woman drop as: That is, a harlot who gives herself to someone other than her husband.
oil: By oil and honey he means flattering and crafty enticements.
feet go down to death: All her doings lead to destruction.
moveable: She has always new means to allure to wickedness.
honour unto others: That is, your strength and goods to her who will have no pity on you as is read of Samson and the prodigal son.
labours be in the house of: The goods gotten by your travel.
assembly: Although I was faithfully instructed in the truth, yet I almost fell to utter shame and destruction nonetheless, by good bringing up in the assembly of the godly.
thine own cistern: He teaches us sobriety exhorting us to live of our own labours and to be beneficial to the godly who want.
thine own: Distribute them not to the wicked and infidels, but reserve them for yourself, your family and them who are of the household of faith.
fountain be blessed: Your children who will come from you in great abundance showing that God blesses marriage and curses whoredom.
youth: Who you married in your youth.
eyes of the LORD: He declares that unless a man joins to his wife both in heart and in outward conversation, he will not escape the judgments of God.
die without instruction: Because he will not give ear to God's word and be admonished.
